اضطرموا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَرَمُوا (iḍṭaramū) /idˤ.tˤa.ra.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# اِضْطَرِمُوا (iḍṭarimū) /idˤ.tˤa.ri.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
